newsitem.title: USA: Barnett to buy First of America franchise.
newsitem.headline: Barnett to buy First of America franchise.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc. said Monday it has a definitive agreement to acquire the Florida franchise of First of America Bank Corp. for $160 million in cash.

The franchise -- Which operates under the name First of America - Florida, FSB -- consists of $1.1 billion in assets, $931 million in deposits and 41 banking offices mainly on Florida's west coast. The company also manages 17 supermarket branches in Albertson's stores throughout Florida.
The acquisition will further strengthen Barnett's leading position in the Tampa Bay and Sarasota markets and add deposits in the fast-growing Fort Myers, Fla., area, it said.
The deal is set to close during the third quarter, subject to regulatory approvals. It is expected to boost earnings slightly this year, Barnett said.
Barnett, based in Jacksonville, Fla., is the largest financial institution in Florida and among the top 25 in the country.
First of America is based in Kalamazoo, Mich.
Barnett's stock rose 25 cents to $54.125, while First of America fell 25 cents to $47.75 in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange at midafternoon.
